title: How to Avoid the Debt Spiral
excerpt: A debt spiral occurs when you're borrowing money to pay off existing debt, leading to an ever-increasing cycle of debt. Here's how to avoid it.
imageAlt: A hand holding a fan of Rand notes

body.text: A debt spiral occurs when you're borrowing money to pay off existing debt, leading to an ever-increasing cycle of debt. Here's how to avoid it:
Track your income and expenses to understand your financial situation. Identify areas where you can cut back on spending.
Having savings for unexpected expenses prevents the need to rely on credit when emergencies arise.

items: List all your debts with their interest rates
Consider the snowball or avalanche method for debt repayment
Make more than minimum payments when possible

body.text: While paying off existing debt, avoid taking on new credit obligations unless absolutely necessary.
If you're struggling with debt, consider consulting a financial advisor or debt counselor for guidance.
Look for ways to earn additional income through part-time work or selling unused items.
